sections.title: Late or quiet
sections.sql: select name,subsidiary,kind,due_date,currency,remaining_value from v_orders where status='open' and (due_date<current_date or coalesce(last_contact,current_date-8)<current_date-7)

sections.title: Dispatch by warehouse
sections.sql: select * from v_dispatch order by due_date

sections.title: Reorder position
sections.sql: select * from v_stock order by subsidiary,item

name: group
title: Group exceptions
subtitle: Currencies stay separate. Intercompany records are reconciled, never posted.

sections.title: Intercompany reconciliation
sections.sql: select * from v_intercompany order by reference

sections.title: Open orders by entity
sections.sql: select subsidiary,currency,kind,sum(remaining_value) open_value from v_orders where status='open' group by subsidiary,currency,kind order by subsidiary,kind
